sources.citation: Chongowe, Bakari & Joseph Hokororo Ismail. 2022. The Study of Tone in Kinguu Infinitive Verbs. International Journal of English Literature and Social Sciences 7(2): 15-22. doi:10.22161/ijels.72.2
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Tone-only study: Kinguu has lexical and grammatical tone (p.16); stem-initial H copies/shifts to the penultimate syllable, word-final syllable is Low, H on a monosyllabic stem hops back to the prefix (pp.17-22). No statement about word stress in Kinguu; only a general Bantu remark (p.15) that verbal H is attracted 'to the penultimate stress syllable', credited to MacSaveny 2009 on Chizigula.
